preconditions: The in-run screen advises only until calibrated: (1) read lodestar_mem_anon_mappings from the musl release build with override for about an hour, since the gauge's arena rule is stricter than mem-cheap's; (2) replay the analyzer over r4 and r5 to calibrate the mimalloc and segment thresholds. Until then an in-run trip is a prompt to look, not a stop on its own. The sweep isn't affected.
about: X-soak-screen's frozen thresholds (docs/decisions/2026-11-07-X-soak-screen.md). An early warning before and during a soak: a trip means stop and investigate; ok never means pass. The CR-0 gate does not read this file. Every counter trips when its value is strictly above its threshold; at the threshold it is ok.

mmap_cache_entries_per_1000_stored.reason: Live mappings the tantivy cache keeps should follow the segments, which merges bound. A searcher or mapping that is never released grows with commits, about one commit per stored torrent.
mmap_cache_entries_per_1000_stored.clean: r5: the cache tracked the live files to the end (main 24, files 72; 34 and 82 files on disk), so its growth is bounded by the segment count's. The r5-shaped fixture's merge sawtooth (files 8 to 21 segments every 1.5 h) reads up to 15 at hour 3, 4 at hour 6, 1 at hour 12.
mmap_cache_entries_per_1000_stored.margin: 2.6 times the fixture's worst (hour 3); a leak of one mapping per commit reads about 1,000

mmap_cache_excess.unit: entries beyond 8 per live segment, either index
mmap_cache_excess.reason: A segment maps at most 8 files, so entries past 8 per segment are mappings no live segment explains.
mmap_cache_excess.clean: r5's end: files 72 - 8 x 15 = -48; main is likewise negative.

segments_per_1000_stored.reason: Merges bound the segment count; one segment per commit that never merges reads about 1,000.
segments_per_1000_stored.clean: r5: file-index segments ended at 15, peak 21: bounded, so near 0 over a window; the fixture's merge sawtooth reads 3 at hour 3, 0.8 at hour 6.
segments_per_1000_stored.margin: 3.3 times the fixture's worst (hour 3); stopped merges read about 1,000

segments.reason: Search fans out over every segment; a count past this means merges aren't keeping up.

anon_mappings_128k_512k_per_1000_stored.reason: Soak r4's C heap (zig's musl malloc) grew as 128-512 KiB anonymous mappings outside mimalloc's arena that were never returned.
anon_mappings_128k_512k_per_1000_stored.clean: 0: with mimalloc's override the mem-cheap harness keeps the class at 0 for all 10,000 torrents.
anon_mappings_128k_512k_per_1000_stored.margin: r4 read about 200 (1,843 -> 2,085 in 1.9 h, about 0.2 per stored torrent): 10 times the threshold

anon_mappings_128k_512k.reason: A level no build with one allocator should reach.
anon_mappings_128k_512k.clean: 0 in the mem-cheap harness with override.
anon_mappings_128k_512k.margin: r4 held 1,843 to 2,085: 3.6 times the threshold

mimalloc_committed_mib_per_1000_stored.reason: In musl builds mimalloc holds the Rust and C heaps, so a heap leak of either grows its committed bytes with the corpus.
mimalloc_committed_mib_per_1000_stored.clean: r5: flat at 568 MiB over hours 12-24; hours 0-12 weren't published, so the fixture assumes 520 rising to 568 MiB over hours 0-6 (11.7 at hours 3 and 6, 5.9 at hour 12). r5's private memory, which isn't an input, rose about 10 per 1,000 over hours 16-24.
mimalloc_committed_mib_per_1000_stored.margin: about 1.7 times the fixture's assumed early fill; recalibrate from the first screened run

mimalloc_committed_mib.reason: A committed heap past this is far beyond any passing soak.

fetch_pending.reason: The fetch pool's cap (PoolConfig::max_pending). At the cap is backpressure; above it, the cap isn't holding.
fetch_pending.clean: r3 and r5 filled the pool to the cap and never passed it.

fetch_held_mib.reason: The pool's held-bytes budget is 64 MiB (max_held_bytes); fetches already running can pass it by what they bring.
fetch_held_mib.clean: not in r5 (the gauge came later); bounded by the budget by design.

retention_bytes_per_commit.unit: live-heap bytes per one-document commit (dhat curr_bytes, commits 500-2,500)
retention_bytes_per_commit.reason: Soak r3's leak: tantivy's mmap cache kept a dead entry per file, 1-3 KB a commit. The same bound as bench/tests/mmap_retention.rs.
retention_bytes_per_commit.clean: 32 with pruning on (release, 2026-11-07); r3's arm (pruning off) read 2,513
retention_bytes_per_commit.margin: 268 B above clean (9.4 times); the control arm reads 8.4 times the threshold

musl_anon_under_512k_per_1000_torrents.unit: anonymous mappings under 512 KiB outside the arena per 1,000 torrents (mem-cheap on musl, OLS from 1,000 torrents)
musl_anon_under_512k_per_1000_torrents.reason: Soak r4's growth (zig's musl malloc never returning small mappings). Without override the harness grows the 128-512 KiB class (r4's) and the smaller one, at a far lower rate than production; their sum keeps the control arm clear of the threshold.
musl_anon_under_512k_per_1000_torrents.clean: 0.00 with override: 4 mappings from 1,000 to 10,000 torrents (2026-11-07, the decision)
musl_anon_under_512k_per_1000_torrents.margin: the control arm (override off) read 17.28 on the same machine: 8.6 times the threshold; r4 read about 200 in its class alone
